one_line: A young republican envoy from the Shakya and Koliya clans, sent to negotiate water-sharing on the Rohini River in the 5th century BCE.

appearance.age_look: Mid-20s, lean and athletic build, average height.
appearance.face: Oval face, warm medium-brown complexion, straight nose, strong but gentle jawline, sharp dark eyes with thick brows, a faint vertical frown line between the brows, default expression calm, attentive and slightly serious.
appearance.hair: Thick black hair pulled back into a short topknot at the crown, sides and back neatly trimmed close, held with a narrow dark-brown leather cord; no turban or helmet, just a simple, practical style.
appearance.costume: Knee-length undyed off-white cotton tunic (similar to an early kurta) with long fitted sleeves and a modest round neckline, worn over a reddish-brown cotton dhoti wrapped tightly and knotted at the front, pleats falling just below the knees; around his torso a plain dark-blue cotton uttariya (shawl) draped from the left shoulder across the chest and wrapped once around the waist like a belt, the end hanging near the right hip; simple dark-brown leather belt over the shawl at the waist; lightweight plain brown leather sandals; minimal jewellery—one small copper bangle on the right wrist and a thin copper earring ring in the left ear; textiles are plain weave, no elaborate prints, only a thin darker-blue border stripe at the edge of the uttariya.
appearance.signature: A plain wooden walking staff the height of his shoulder, smooth and slightly tapered, with a simple carved ring near the top that he grips when speaking, symbolising both travel and his role as messenger between the Shakya and Koliya councils.

ref_desc: Young medium-brown man with oval face, black topknot hair, off-white long-sleeved tunic, reddish-brown dhoti, dark-blue shawl, brown leather belt and sandals, minimal copper jewellery, and a plain shoulder-height wooden staff as his constant prop, in these fixed colours.
sheet_prompt: Draw a full-body anime-style model sheet of a young medium-brown man from 5th century BCE north Indian gana-sanghas, shown front, three-quarter, and back: he has an oval face, straight nose, strong jawline, sharp dark eyes, and a calm, serious default expression with a faint frown line between the brows; his thick black hair is pulled into a short topknot at the crown, sides and back neatly trimmed, tied with a narrow dark-brown leather cord, with no headgear; he wears a knee-length undyed off-white cotton tunic with long fitted sleeves and a modest round neck, over a tightly wrapped reddish-brown cotton dhoti knotted in front with pleats falling just below the knees; a plain dark-blue cotton uttariya (shawl) is draped from his left shoulder across his chest and wrapped once around his waist like a belt, its end hanging near his right hip, and a simple dark-brown leather belt is fastened over the shawl at the waist; his feet are in lightweight plain brown leather sandals; add one small copper bangle on his right wrist and a thin copper ring earring in his left ear, otherwise no jewellery; place a plain wooden walking staff, shoulder-height, smooth and slightly tapered with a carved ring near the top, in his right hand as his signature prop; keep the colours consistent—off-white tunic, reddish-brown dhoti, dark-blue shawl, dark-brown belt and sandals, warm medium-brown skin, black hair, and subtle copper accents—using clean flat tones and clear linework suitable for a shonen anime character sheet.
